title: Hemel Storm top Reading Rockets to conquer NBL D1 playoff title
description: Reading R. - Hemel Storm 84-87 American guard Taylor Johnson (193-1994, college: Dartmouth) stepped up and scored 26 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists for the winners and guard Sam Newman (191-1996) chipped in 18 points, 5 rebounds, 8 assists and 5 steals. Storm's coach Mark Clark used a ten-player rotation in such tough game. At the losing side Australian guard Mitchell Clarke (186-1999) responded with 16 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists and American guard Elijah Maynard (193-1996, college: WAU) scored 15 points and 5 rebounds. Four Storm and five Rockets players scored in double figures.
